messages:
Alex K: quick check — landing runway for Optimize toolkit this week. three quick asks: who owns the final quantization recs PR, who will own the batching/caching config rollout, and can we confirm there's a canary window that won't trigger the regression alert?

Maya R: I own the quant recs PR now. plan is to merge after one last perf run (today). cc @Tony L for review. expected merge by EOD if perf looks stable. :thumbsup:

Tony L: taking review now. gave initial comments in the PR. small change to the `downcast` path, otherwise looks good. will approve after CI passes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/pull/1247 

Samir P: heads up — runtime needs a tiny KV cache API tweak in eng-runtime before we flip the new `prefix_kv` default. ticket RT-3124. if that lands late we should gate rollout with a flag. I can pick up the runtime change but ETA is tomorrow morning PST.

Natalie S: okay for rollout ownership — I can own the batching/caching rollout (coord with infra). plan: feature-flag the new defaults, canary 24h in us-west1 at 10% traffic, then 50% -> full if no regressions. will post the exact traffic window in a follow-up.

Alex K: perfect. two action items then: (1) @Maya merge quant recs after perf run, (2) @Natalie own canary/flags and block if RT-3124 hasn't merged. can someone confirm the regression eval that tripped earlier — is it the same prompt set as the nightly eval?

Maya R: regression alert was from the weekly smoke-suite (prompt-set: smoke_v2). I re-ran locally against the new quant profile and saw a tiny BLEU drop on one prompt — investigating if it's noise or real. tagging `eval-bench` results once I have numbers.

Tony L: CI for PR shows one flaky inference test failing — looks timing-related. rerun helped locally. CI/azure shows `integration/infer_timeout` failing in one matrix cell. I'll kick another run. :eyes:

deploy-bot: CI update for PR 1247 — checks started, 4/8 passed. failing: integration/infer_timeout (flaky). re-run queued.

Samir P: if flaky persists, we can add a small backoff in the test harness to reduce spurious failures. that won't affect production behavior.

Natalie S: planning the canary schedule around the next low-traffic window: tomorrow 01:00-03:00 UTC. I'll open a tiny deploy card and invite runtime + infra. will also add a rollback playbook.

Alex K: thanks. final note — can we get a quick CR ping thread when PRs are ready? short checklist in the PR description helps reviewers (perf numbers, eval run id, canary flag name).

Maya R: added checklist to PR: "perf-run: r12345", "eval-id: smoke_v2-2026-03-18", "canary-flag: optkit_kv_v2". ping me here if you need the eval artifacts.

Tony L: re-run passed: all checks green now. approved and ready for merge on Maya ack. :shipit:

deploy-bot: PR 1247 — all checks passed. merge allowed.

Alex K: awesome. @Maya please merge and drop a short note here when merged. @Natalie open deploy card and tag runtime. we'll treat RT-3124 as blocker if not in by tomorrow morning. thanks everyone — short and tidy :)

Maya R: merged. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/commit/9f8c7a2 — perf run looks within targets. eval artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/evals/smoke_v2-2026-03-18.zip

Natalie S: deploy card created: https://cards.redwood.ai/deploy/optkit-1247 — canary scheduled 01:00-03:00 UTC, us-west1 10% -> 50% -> 100%. runtime tagged: @Samir P. Rollback steps included.

Alex K: closing loop — leaving this thread as the single source of truth for ownership and schedule. will follow up in the shiproom doc with post-mortem if any regressions pop. thanks :tada:
